methods_limit: Semantic full read of five driver/test sources, three Markdown documents, dependency pins and provenance JSON. Raw artifacts receive exhaustive byte/hash and structural/cross-record checks, not manual semantic approval of every field. Missing portable audit and current CodeQL annotations not reconstructed.

findings.finding: Frozen 55 normal plus eight fault SDK-only samples cannot qualify current modified SDK, hosted backend, Collector, kernel/PTY, hostile process, detached descendants or durable recovery. Truth is application-level loopback/file/child readback; background thread is joined. No benchmark rerun performed.

Host-exporter automatic Fabric and OpenInference rows retain synthetic exception-canary leakage despite content-hide settings. Managed Fabric/custom OTel exception-redaction probes remove that canary, but are separate functional probes and not matched latency rows or general arbitrary-content privacy proof.

63 expected empty stderr logs absent from supplied archive; omission names/hashes retained. 26 published files disclose benchmark-venv path substitution; indexed hashes bind published transformed bytes. No original pre-transform bytes reconstructed.

Crash probe abrupt os._exit proves loss in in-memory batch tier, not power-loss durability: truth file is not fsynced, no restart replay configured. Export first-failure intentionally loses a record. Call capture and sink delivery are separate counters; bypass requires external inventory.

Version pins have no distribution hashes. Driver reports source/truth mismatch booleans instead of aborting campaign; observed frozen flags indicate stable source and truth. Timings shared-container/unpaired bootstrap and adapter physical-line counts do not establish general superiority, complete setup cost or human onboarding effort.

Explicit file action writes declared synthetic canary to artifact.bin as workload/readback truth. Exact canary fixture bytes checked in 63 artifacts and preserved; no real customer secret established. Intentional fixture classification is evidence, not suppression/dismissal or security acceptance. Initial 165-alert triage includes this record; current 58 alert annotations not independently retrievable in this session.
